newsitem.title: USA: Haverty Furniture Feb same-store sales off.
newsitem.headline: Haverty Furniture Feb same-store sales off.

text.p: Haverty Furniture Cos Inc on Tuesday said February sales rose 3.1 percent to a record $40.2 million compared with $39.0 million in February 1996, while same-store sales fell 2.0 percent.

Since Haverty uses the regular calendar for monthly reporting periods, February 1996 sales had one extra day included due to the leap year. The one-day reduction for February 1997 equates to a 3.4 percent decrease in the comparable number of days.
